answer:
The President of the United States in the year that Citibank was founded (1812) was **James Madison**. 

Citibank was originally founded as City Bank of New York on June 16, 1812, and James Madison served as the fourth U.S. President from 1809 to 1817. Notably, during his presidency in 1812, Madison signed a declaration of war against Britain, which led to the War of 1812 - the same year Citibank was established.
